_sensex_note: 2026-08-07 onboarding: strategy_app_sensex/execution_app_sensex/seller_app_sensex entries are deliberately NOT in `services` yet -- those containers don't exist (cold start, Phase 5/6/7 pending, see docs/ONBOARDING_INSTRUMENT.md). The checker's main loop iterates every key under `services` and tries `docker exec <key> printenv`, so adding them now would make this UNREACHABLE-fail permanently at the 09:00 IST daily run for containers that were never meant to be running. Add the 3 entries back to `services` in the SAME commit that actually starts each container, matching how FINNIFTY's entries were added at its Stage 3 paper launch, not at registry time.

option_trading-strategy_app-1._comment: 2026-08-10: calculated-risk loosening (user decision after a 'no trades' review) -- ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP turned on (CHOP was BankNifty's single largest regime bucket that day, 38% of bars, previously fully excluded). ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB deliberately left at its original 0.6, NOT lowered alongside it -- reverted an initial 0.6->0.55 change same-day to isolate CHOP as the only variable; lowering the threshold inside a regime being reopened specifically for false-signal risk would have compounded, not just added to, that risk, and muddied which change did what. Revisit the threshold as its own decision once CHOP-alone has been observed. PRE_EXPIRY and STRATEGY_MIN_CONFIDENCE deliberately left untouched -- PRE_EXPIRY's risk is an unprotected gap (-16.3% in one bar, a different risk category than CHOP's 'market didn't move' losses), decided separately. 2026-08-20: DIRECTION_ML_MIN_MARGIN turned on at 0.05 -- BankNifty is the only instrument on ML-primary direction_ml mode (NIFTY/FINNIFTY/SENSEX all use the more conservative composite mode with their own margin gates); direction_dhan_bn_v3.joblib's holdout AUC is a weak 0.6165, and the margin gate had existed in code since 2026-07-19 but was left at its 0-disables-it default, so real historical direction calls included genuine near-coinflip commits (e.g. ce_prob=0.5194) with nothing to abstain them. Calibrated 0.05 against the real live probability distribution (21 historical direction_ml decisions: 2 fell below this margin, 19 above) -- filters the most degenerate near-toss-up cases without meaningfully cutting into real trade frequency, which was the whole reason CHOP got reopened in the first place. 2026-09-04: root-caused the Jul 20-23 buyer regression (dhan_entry_015pct_v1 was a known-weak model, holdout AUC 0.618, deployed despite explicit gate failures -- see .env.compose history). A same-methodology 15-min retrain on now-fully-clean data only reached AUC 0.636, confirming BankNifty's ceiling at this horizon isn't a data-pipeline artifact. A forgotten 2026-07-12 5-min-horizon rare-label approach scored much better (0.739 on stale data); retrained fresh it reaches holdout AUC 0.725, ship gates 3/4 pass (fails separation). Engine-level, capital-weighted backtest (Feb-Jul 2026, tier==live) showed only +0.52% return on capital vs the old model's +0.58% -- essentially flat, with worse tail risk -- so this is NOT a proven edge. Deployed anyway 2026-09-04 as a deliberate live trial per user instruction, to observe real trades before deciding whether to keep it, tune it further, or revert to dhan_entry_015pct_v1.joblib (untouched on disk, zero-file-change rollback).

option_trading-strategy_app_nifty-1._comment: 2026-08-10: calculated-risk loosening, same isolated pattern as BankNifty -- ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP on (CHOP was ~20% of NIFTY's bars over a 3-day sample, previously fully excluded), ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB left untouched to isolate the variable. Sourced from the namespaced NIFTY_ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP in .env.compose, not the bare var BankNifty/historical/sim containers use. 2026-08-20: retrained on the fully-fixed historical data (schema-drift + IV-scale + ctx_gap fixes) -- v1 holdout AUC 0.6294/ship_gates none pass -> v2 holdout AUC 0.7327/ship_gates all pass. ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB left untouched, same isolate-the-variable discipline.

option_trading-strategy_app_sensex-1._comment: 2026-08-10: cold-start v1 model, holdout AUC 0.6845 (fails formal >=0.70 gate) but real separation/calibration -- threshold 0.70 picked from a genuine quantization cliff (0.7-0.8 bin: 75% precision, n=8; 0.6-0.7 bin: 0% precision, n=6). Small holdout sample -- RISK_LIVE_MIN_GRADE=GOOD is the compensating control. Launching buyer-side paper mode only; retrain once more live data accumulates.

option_trading-seller_app-1._comment: 2026-08-22: SELLER_IV_RANK_MIN lowered 30->15 for BankNifty only (BANKNIFTY_SELLER_IV_RANK_MIN override) after it sat with zero trades since 2026-07-27 at floor=30. 19-month backtest showed floor=15 is P&L-flat and tail-risk-unchanged vs floor=30, just unlocks more trading days. NIFTY/FINNIFTY/SENSEX keep the shared default of 30.

option_trading-execution_app_nifty-1._comment: Added 2026-08-04: NIFTY's execution/seller containers had NO contract coverage at all (live money, zero drift detection) while BankNifty and FINNIFTY both did. Values pinned from the running container.
